sqlquery.from:
( select max(customer) customer , sum( case when si.iscreditnote = true then ((i.subtotal-i.totaldiscount)/i.exchangeRate)*(-1) else ((i.subtotal-i.totaldiscount)/i.exchangeRate) end) amount -- , sum((case when si.isCreditNote then(-1) else 1 end)*i.subtotal) amount , max(cur.name) currencyname from (select ca.id, ca.name customer from "$".crmaccount ca join "$".crmAccount_types cat on ca.id=cat.crmaccount_id join "$".reference tp on cat.type_id=tp.id where ca.deleted is not true and tp.code ='CUSTOMER') ca left join "$".saleinvoice si on ca.id=si.client_id join "$".invoice i on si.id=i.id and i.type = 'RECEIVABLE' left join "$".reference st on i.status_id=st.id left join "public".company comp on comp.id=$ left join "public".financialsettings fs on comp.financialSettingsId=fs.id left join "public".currency cur on fs.currency_id=cur.id
where st.code in ('OVER_DUE','PAID','APPROVE','OPEN') group by ca.id ) t
